artifacts.summary: Recommends moving specs/paper-definitions-of-record.md to docs/reference/ and specs/decisions/*.md to docs/architecture/ (folded into its existing non-ADR Specification Documents table), since docs/architecture/README.md already forbids a second docs/decisions/ location; enumerates every script, Lean docstring, and markdown consumer that needs repointing.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, docs/architecture/README.md explicitly states there is exactly one ADR/decision-record convention (docs/architecture/) and that a docs/decisions/ directory must not be created as a duplicate. When relocating decision-record-shaped files out of specs/, fold them into docs/architecture/'s existing 'Specification Documents' table (non-ADR-numbered) rather than creating a new decisions directory.

scripts/check-module-invariants.sh's C15 check hardcodes the paper-definitions-of-record path as a shell variable (C15_RECORD, not a markdown citation), and scripts/check-paper-definitions.sh hardcodes it as RECORD_DEFAULT. Both are easy to miss when grepping only for markdown-style citations because they are ordinary shell assignments, not prose references.
